home.descChico: For the past 3 years, I have been building a comic book universe starring Chico, a boy who lives in a fantasy world and dreams of exploring the vast lands of the planet, just like his parents. On his journey, Chico meets extraordinary creatures and discovers that the world isn't all roses, as he once imagined.
home.descCamisas: What started out as just drawings, today adds up to 3 sketchbooks of characters, scripts, keychains, stickers, and even t-shirt and hoodie prints featuring Chico and other characters from the plot.
